technology_name: Dehumidified Dryer Technology for Agricultural Crops
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Inefficient crop drying methods that lead to loss of nutrients and high energy consumption.
description: A dehumidified dryer system for agricultural crops operating via a refrigeration system. It circulates dehumidified air at 40-50°C using a finned tube heat exchanger, evaporator, and condenser.
applications: Processing and post-harvest drying of commercial fruits , Dehydration of high-value plantation spices and herbs .Preservation drying of ornamental flowers and botanicals , Integration into small-scale decentralized agro-processing units
